## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/anthropic/chat/guardrail_translation/handler.py

Prompts

```
['apply guardrails to Anthropic input messages by extracting text and images, then applying responses back', 'apply guardrails to Anthropic output responses by extracting text from content blocks and updating text fields', 'apply guardrails to streaming Anthropic responses by accumulating text and checking against the guardrail', 'extract text content and images from an Anthropic input message, handling string and list content formats', 'extract text content and tool calls from an Anthropic response content block, handling text and tool_use types']
```

Usage

```
{'apply_guardrail_to_input_messages': 'apply guardrails to Anthropic input messages by extracting text and images, then applying responses back', 'apply_guardrail_to_output_response': 'apply guardrails to Anthropic output responses by extracting text from content blocks and updating text fields', 'apply_guardrail_to_streaming_response': 'apply guardrails to streaming Anthropic responses by accumulating text and checking against the guardrail', 'extract_input_text_and_images': 'extract text content and images from an Anthropic input message, handling string and list content formats', 'extract_output_text_and_images': 'extract text content and tool calls from an Anthropic response content block, handling text and tool_use types'}
```
